The season ran from 21 February to 25 October 2009. [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro Atlético]] were the defending champions. The league comprised 14 teams and the bottom three were relegated to the 2010 [[Gira Angola]]. [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro Atlético de Luanda]] were crowned champions,{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2009/9/42/Agosto-victory-causes-title-celebration-for-Petro-advance,ff29c922-8f31-419e-83d9-dd50081503fa.html |title=1º de Agosto's victory causes title celebration for Petro in advance |publisher=ANGOP.com |date= 18 Oct 2009 |access-date= 7 Sep 2015}} while [[Académica Petróleos do Lobito|Académica do Lobito]], [[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|Primeiro de Maio]] and [[Kabuscorp S.C.P.|Kabuscorp]] were relegated. [[David Dinis Magalhães|David Magalhães]] of [[Atlético Petróleos Luanda|Petro Luanda]] finished as top scorer with 19 goals.{{cite web |url=http://www.fafutebol-angola.og.ao/noticias/noticias.php?id=274 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091219124609/http://www.fafutebol-angola.og.ao/noticias/noticias.php?id=274 |url-status=dead |archive-date=December 19, 2009 |title=David melhor marcador do Girabola 2009 |access-date=17 Sep 2015 |publisher=Federação Angolana de Futebol |language=pt }} ==Changes from 2008 season== '''Relegated:''' [[S.L.
